# Palnadu.dev

> Problem-first software engineering studio and digital technology partner based in Palnadu, Andhra Pradesh.

Palnadu.dev builds web applications, Android & iOS mobile applications, startup Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and custom business automation systems for regional enterprises and startups across Andhra Pradesh and worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Website Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/website-development): High-performance corporate websites and institutional platforms built with Next.js.
- [Web Applications](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/web-development): Scalable SaaS products, commercial portals, dashboards, and custom web applications.
- [Mobile Applications](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/mobile-app-development): Production iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile apps.
- [Android App Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/android-app-development): Native and cross-platform Android mobile applications for regional commerce.
- [iOS App Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/ios-app-development): Premium iOS mobile applications built for iPhone and iPad.
- [Idea Validation](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/idea-validation): Technical feasibility assessment, customer workflow analysis, and MVP roadmap scoping.
- [MVP Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/mvp-development): Rapid 3-to-6-week minimum viable product launches with 100% source code ownership.
- [Custom Software](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/custom-software): Tailored software designed around specific business workflows and requirements.
- [Business Automation](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/business-automation): Elimination of repetitive manual spreadsheets and paper slips through custom portals.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven technical SEO, Google Search optimization, and local visibility.
- [Technical Consulting](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/technical-consulting): Architecture reviews, technology selection, and system analysis.
